entities.name: Rēzekne I – Daugavpils railway line
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Rēzekne I–Daugavpils Railway is an 84 kilometres (52 mi) long, 1,524 mm gauge railway line in southeastern Latvia. The railway connects the cities and railway hubs of Rēzekne and Daugavpils.
